description.value: A family-owned budget motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, operating since the 1970s with 34 ground-floor rooms. Kitchenettes with microwaves and fridges make it practical for self-catering travellers, and a heated outdoor pool and whirlpool offer a welcome end-of-day recovery option. It sits next door to restaurants and five minutes from downtown, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley corridor.

address.value: 1767 Trans Canada Hwy E, Kamloops, BC V2C 3Z6
